questions.question: Payment application supporting OCP when adding new payment methods:

options.B: Create a Payment interface with a pay() method and implement it in CardPayment, UpiPayment, etc.
options.D: Make Payment class abstract without interface

questions.correct_answer: B. Create a Payment interface with a pay() method and implement it in CardPayment, UpiPayment, and other payment classes.
questions.explanation: Polymorphism via interfaces enables OCP.

questions.question: In Java 7, interfaces can contain:
